content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day horizon, especially after recent spikes.
- Overestimates prices in the middle to late horizon when prices are trending downward or consolidating.
- Shows significant lag in reacting to recent price drops — forecasts remain high longer than actuals.
- Overshoots after sharp upward moves (e.g., 70+ to 74+), then fails to correct downward quickly.
- Tends to overfit recent volatility, leading to overreaction in short-term forecasts.
- Mean reversion is underemphasized — model holds onto high forecasts longer than actuals revert.
- Forecasts often peak too early in the horizon, missing the lagged correction phase.
- Underestimates the magnitude of downward corrections after spikes, especially in the 10–20 day window.
- Sensitive to recent low prices — forecasts tend to be too low when recent 7–10 day lows are below 65.
